recent.title: LOCAL SYSTEM ENVIRONMENT FOR CLOUD BASED DEVELOPMENT
OPTIMIZING CONTAINER STARTUP PERFORMANCE USING BLOCK LAYER STORAGE

patents.source: USPTO Open Data Portal, granted patents since 2001, applicant phrase "anyscale", 2026-09-13

profile_text.body:
Anyscale is a for-profit startup founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. According to its website, it is powered by Ray and helps AI builders run data-intensive workloads to build and deploy foundation models and AI at scale on any cloud. The site describes orchestration of model training across GPU clusters with elastic scaling, last-mile data preprocessing, and GPU observability.

The site presents the company's position as infrastructure for production-scale AI. It quotes Anastasis Germanidis saying Anyscale allows his team to scale workloads seamlessly, removing infrastructure risk so the team can focus on innovation rather than infrastructure bottlenecks. It also quotes an unnamed applied AI engineer describing a model that went from selection to production in a day, where before Anyscale that would have taken a week or more.

No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded for the company. California is the jurisdiction listed for its legal exposure.
